title: TESLA: Taylor Expansion of Sinusoidal Learnable Activations
abstract: arXiv:2608.11970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The parity problem--deciding whether the number of ones in a binary vector is odd or even--remains challenging for standard neural networks due to linear inseparability and the need for global interactions. We propose TESLA, an activation defined as a learnable combination of sine and cosine terms, enabling explicit control over polynomial degree and selective amplification of high-order components. Theoretically, we show that constraining TESLA's coefficients yields Lipschitz/Rademacher complexity bounds and shapes the training dynamics to emphasize higher-frequency structure. Empirically, on parity with input length n = 32, TESLA attains strong generalization with 100K training samples (approximately 0.002% of the 2^32 input space) and remains robust under heavy corruption, retaining high accuracy with up to 30% label noise. translated_title: TESLA：正弦可学习激活函数的泰勒展开
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11970v1 公告类型：新 摘要：奇偶性问题——判断二进制向量中1的个数是奇数还是偶数——由于线性不可分性和对全局交互的需求，对标准神经网络仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了TESLA，一种定义为正弦和余弦项的可学习组合的激活函数，能够显式控制多项式次数并选择性地放大高阶分量。理论上，我们证明了约束TESLA的系数可得到Lipschitz/Rademacher复杂度界，并塑造训练动态以强调更高频率的结构。实验上，在输入长度n=32的奇偶性任务中，TESLA仅用10万个训练样本（约占2^32输入空间的0.002%）即可实现强泛化，并在严重损坏下保持鲁棒性，在高达30%的标签噪声下仍保持高准确率。我们还与周期性和基于频率的基线方法（SIREN、SNAKE和傅里叶特征嵌入）进行了比较。
tldr: TESLA通过可学习正弦余弦组合的激活函数，显式控制多项式阶数并放大高频分量，在奇偶性任务上以极少量样本实现强泛化，并抵抗高标签噪声。
en_tdlr: TESLA uses a learnable sine-cosine activation with explicit polynomial degree control and high-frequency amplification, achieving strong generalization on parity tasks with minimal samples and robustness to high label noise.
